name: Cutover Runbook - Waiting On One Answer

cutoverDecisions.answer: Nadia has the GoDaddy login and will make the record edits herself with Jared on a call; we never hold the credentials.
Split it — the example sponsors come down before cutover; board bios and the donation platform can be filled in live.
Gate the design gallery behind the same passphrase as the review site, so the board's link keeps working.
Status page moves to the review site only. Neither it nor this runbook belongs on the public domain.

description: Everything decided except the date — one unanswered question, one blocked step, and the wording in the singular. Two reasons this earns a scenario rather than being a data variation of the others. It is the singular boundary of the summary sentence, which is the case a hand-written count gets wrong because nobody seeds exactly one blocked step while looking at the page. And it is the shape this migration actually stalls in: the work is ready, one answer is outstanding, and the page has to make that legible enough that the answer gets given rather than deferred again.
